feedbacks.comment: Dr. Chaminda was very thorough and took the time to explain my blood pressure medications and lifestyle changes in simple Sinhala. The nurses were friendly and efficient. Minor wait at the reception, but overall a very satisfying experience. Highly recommended.

The doctor was very knowledgeable and explained my thyroid issue clearly. I felt reassured after the consultation. The lab results came quickly. Waiting room can get crowded during peak hours — some air conditioning improvement would be welcome.

I came in having trouble breathing and was seen within 20 minutes. The doctor explained exactly what was happening with my lungs. Chest X-ray was done on the same day. My only concern is parking — it can be difficult during morning hours.

The nurse checked my vitals promptly and the doctor reviewed my inhaler technique carefully — no one had done that before. My asthma has been much better since the treatment was adjusted. The written action plan they gave me has been a lifesaver!

Very professional service. Doctor explained my cholesterol and diabetes connection in detail and referred me to a dietician as well. Would have liked the cashier counter to be faster, but the overall experience was great.

Dr. Priyanka was exceptional — she took a full history, ordered an ECG immediately and explained the findings clearly. Her patience in answering all my questions about my kidney condition was very reassuring. The cardiology unit is well equipped.

The doctor was good and thorough. However I had to wait almost 45 minutes past my appointment time. The air conditioning in the waiting area was not working properly and it was very uncomfortable. Please improve the waiting experience.
